name: TokenEconomizer LLM judge and micro-skill proposer
summary: TokenEconomizer's model-based quality judge and its proposer of model-written micro-skills. Rejected: neither is validated, and generated text in always-loaded files is a persistence path for injected instructions. Tests and human review do the job. Both make model calls.

evidence.setting: Design review; no validation of either feature found
evidence.effect: Unvalidated; generated text in always-loaded files is a persistence path for injected instructions

egress.default: helper model calls to the agent's own provider

maintenance: Part of the TokenEconomizer plugin; micro-skills are off by default.
